{"notes": "Visit 3 (left at 5:00). I still don't know who placed which dominoes; ratings rest on claims plus the picture.

Sofia: Her private status matched her public one. She said she was finishing the top fin (6 left), then closing the gap to Jack's line, then checking the start. At 4:30 she announced the top fin was laid, and the picture shows it dark and connected round to (27,10). She credited Hana for the gap catch and kept Jack and Omar on their own parts, which is good coordination and leadership. Still unclear what she laid herself.

Omar: His private account (bottom body line, tail joint, kink on the fin) matches visits 1-2. At 4:45 he stood dominoes back up on the bottom fin's right edge and told Jack to hold off. That is good recovery and communication. The bump that knocked them down is only his report; I didn't see it, so I won't judge Jack on it. Reliable reporter.

Hana: She finally spoke, and well. She gave an accurate overview, spotted a gap near the top of the fin, told Sofia and stayed out of the corner to avoid collisions. Her earlier gap is now closed: the top fin is dark all the way round. Communication has improved a lot. Her claim that the body is one run is true for toppling, but the top body line ends at about (21.2, 8.9), short of the tail at (23, 10). That is a dead-end branch and a visible gap in the outline. Ask who owns it.

Jack: Silent for three visits. His bottom fin is connected and reaches (28.8, 11.8). His hand is at the right edge, where Omar says the knock happened. I have no direct evidence on his execution this visit. Ask him directly about the incident and what he's laying.

Next: check the top body gap, the bottom fin's right edge, and the final knock-over."}
